title: COSMIC: effectiveness and expansion timeline
asked: Ms He Ting Ru asked what assessment the Government has made of COSMIC's effectiveness in letting financial institutions share information on customers with money laundering red flags, and when the planned expansion to more major banks and a wider range of cases will be implemented.
response: Mr Alvin Tan said MAS launched COSMIC on 1 April 2024 with six major commercial banks, targeting misuse of legal persons, misuse of trade finance, and proliferation financing. He said participant banks filed additional suspicious transaction reports and closed a significant number of suspicious accounts, and that the FATF's recent Mutual Evaluation affirmed COSMIC's effectiveness. MAS is widening COSMIC's scope beyond the three risk areas and onboarding other major banks, with expansion scheduled for completion within two years. In the first year, participant banks filed additional STRs relating to aggregate fund flows of more than $1.6 billion, and more than 1,000 suspicious customer accounts were closed.
